summary: OpenAI previewed 'Ultrafast', a new API service tier powered by Cerebras hardware that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14x faster than standard processing, generating up to 750 output tokens per second, in a limited preview to select customers.

mechanisms.reason: OpenAI is routing a flagship inference workload through Cerebras' specialized wafer-scale silicon rather than standard merchant GPU serving.
mechanisms.quote: Ultrafast marks the next step in our partnership with Cerebras to bring ultra-low-latency inference to OpenAI’s platform.

categories.reason: A frontier lab's flagship model being served on Cerebras chips at scale is a demand signal for Cerebras' specialized accelerator silicon.
categories.quote: Powered by Cerebras, Ultrafast generates up to 750 output tokens per second, bringing our most intelligent model to products and workflows where every second matters.

practices.reason: A dramatically faster response tier for an existing frontier model changes what interactive, time-sensitive products are buildable, but access is currently limited to a preview group.
practices.quote: a new service tier that runs GPT‑5.6 Sol up to 14× faster than Standard processing, launching first in the OpenAI API

practices.reason: The speed gain comes from OpenAI's own infrastructure partnership with Cerebras, not a technique an outside engineering team could apply on its own stack.
practices.quote: Powered by Cerebras, Ultrafast generates up to 750 output tokens per second

practices.reason: The new tier is only reachable via signup during a limited preview, so there is no general integration work to schedule yet.
practices.quote: GPT‑5.6 Sol on Ultrafast mode is available in a limited preview today to a select group of customers.
